component.name: ELASTICSEARCH (SYSTEM, READ-ONLY)
component.description:
What it does Stores documents in your organization's Elasticsearch and finds them again by full-text search - the backbone of a searchable knowledge base, a product catalog or a log of past runs.

How it works Each node runs one operation, chosen in the Inspector. The documents, queries, mappings and settings it needs arrive in the incoming data; the index name can be filled from that data too, with ${field} placeholders. SEARCH matches query_text across the fields you name, or runs a full query_dsl when one arrives. INSERT indexes the whole batch and fails the run if Elasticsearch rejects even one document, so a count is never reported for documents that are not there. Anything else arriving passes through to the next node.

Configure
- Operation - SEARCH, INSERT, CREATE_INDEX, DELETE, LIST_INDICES or DELETE_INDEX.
- Index Name - the index to act on; required for everything except LIST_INDICES.
- Result Count - the most hits SEARCH returns, 1 to 1000.
- Search Fields - comma-separated fields to match query_text against; blank searches them all.

In and out In: documents and optional doc_ids for INSERT; query_text or query_dsl for SEARCH; doc_id or query_dsl for DELETE; mappings and settings for CREATE_INDEX. Out: the incoming data, less those inputs, plus the operation, the index and its result - results and total, insert_count, deleted or indices.

Use it when
- You want people or agents to search your own documents by keyword.
- An orchestration should file each result it produces so it can be found later.
- You need to set up, inspect or clear an index as part of a pipeline.
component.short_description: Indexes, searches and deletes documents in your organization's Elasticsearch.

component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: agent
name: Elasticsearch
description: >
  Runs one operation against the organization's Elasticsearch - search, bulk
  insert, create an index, delete documents, list indices or delete an index.
  The index name accepts ${field} placeholders from request_data. A
  misconfigured node, an Elasticsearch error or a rejected document raises and
  fails the run.

input_ports:
  - port_name: input
    port_type: in
    # The script never reads input.artifact; it always builds its own JSON
    # result. optional(json) - "a json, or nothing" - keeps it chainable after
    # any artifact-producing node.
    artifact_type_input: optional(json)
    request_data:
      documents: array (optional) - Objects to index. Required by INSERT.
      doc_ids: array (optional) - One id per document, for INSERT. Left out, Elasticsearch assigns ids.
      doc_id: string (optional) - The document to delete, for DELETE.
      query_text: string (optional) - Free text matched against Search Fields, for SEARCH.
      query_dsl: object (optional) - An Elasticsearch query. Wins over query_text in SEARCH; selects the documents DELETE removes.
      mappings: object (optional) - Field mappings, for CREATE_INDEX.
      settings: object (optional) - Index settings, for CREATE_INDEX.
    artifact_type_output: json
    # response_data is the incoming request_data, less the payloads this node
    # consumed, with the operation's result on top.
    response_data_passthrough: request_data
    response_data_passthrough_except: [documents, doc_ids, query_text, query_dsl, mappings, settings]
    response_data:
      operation: string - The operation that ran.
      index_name: string - The index acted on; empty for LIST_INDICES.
      results: array (optional) - SEARCH only - matching documents, each with id, score and its fields.
      total: integer (optional) - SEARCH only - total matches Elasticsearch reported.
      index_missing: boolean (optional) - SEARCH only - true when the index does not exist, so no results.
      insert_count: integer (optional) - INSERT only - number of documents indexed.
      deleted: integer (optional) - DELETE only - number of documents removed.
      indices: array (optional) - LIST_INDICES only - index names, sorted.

input_parameters:
  - name: operation
    type: select
    label: Operation
    options: [SEARCH, INSERT, CREATE_INDEX, DELETE, LIST_INDICES, DELETE_INDEX]
    default: SEARCH
    required: true
    description: The Elasticsearch operation this node runs.
  - name: index_name
    type: text
    label: Index Name
    default: ""
    description: The index to act on. Accepts ${field} placeholders. Required for every operation except LIST_INDICES.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SEARCH, INSERT, CREATE_INDEX, DELETE, DELETE_INDEX]
  - name: top_k
    type: integer
    label: Result Count
    default: 10
    constraints:
      min: 1
      max: 1000
    description: The most hits SEARCH returns.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SEARCH]
  - name: search_fields
    type: text
    label: Search Fields
    default: ""
    description: Comma-separated fields query_text is matched against. Blank searches every field.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SEARCH]
